# Bid the run and the circuit, not the head.

> Price a ductless mini-split install from indoor heads, line-set extras, story height, electrical extras, and margin — then see price per head, crew hours, and the walk-away number a cheaper per-head quote hides.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
